non-blocking: the assertion assert argv[argv.index("--local-dir") + 1] == str(site.model_dir(profile)) compares the client argument against the same production accessor the generator resolves MODEL_DIR through (imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1243 computes model_dir = site.model_dir(profile)), so both sides move together and the assertion cannot fail for a change inside SiteConfig.model_dir at imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:768 - it verifies only that the substitution happened, not that the directory is the right one; this is the coupling the brief asks to be named, and it is the same line the prior review flagged at the earlier head.
